当两位正式黑魔法师的身影均渐渐远去后，“咕咕咕”的猫头鹰叫声，才缓缓传来。
其实这些学院监察者早就到了，但可惜就连它们，也不敢贸然参与到两位正式黑魔法师的战斗中。
不知道附近有没有其它黑魔法师在暗中观望，塞恩倒是看到了他认识的那只猫头鹰学院监察者——柒。
之所以能从几只长相酷似的猫头鹰中一眼认出对方，是多次接触下来，塞恩注意到对方胸前的白色羽毛中，有一根是红色的，这有别于其它猫头鹰。
猫头鹰柒估计也看到了塞恩，不过它并没有上前打招呼。
分出两只猫头鹰用于看护周围环境和那只正燃烧着火焰的植物巨怪尸骸后，柒和其它猫头鹰监察者，朝着摩西多大师和凯瑟森离开的方向飞去。
魔索布拉城已经有十几年没爆发过正式黑魔法师之间的战斗了。
也不知道这次战斗是否会给学院或城区造成巨大损失。
“呵呵呵，凯瑟森那家伙既然已经道歉了，并且你还挖出了他那头植宠的生命之心，我看要不这件事就算了吧。”
还是摩西多大师的房间里，今天有一位尊贵的客人造访。
这名来客塞恩还认识，正是魔索布拉城黑魔法学院的三位副院长之一——达达隆大师。
由于前几天发生的两位正式黑魔法师之战还牵扯到了塞恩，所以只是中级学徒水准的塞恩，此时也出现在房间内。
眼前这位达达隆大师丝毫没有几个月前地牢内表现的市侩与阴冷，而是面容和煦，像个邻家老头儿一样，跟摩西多说着暖话。
并且在与摩西多对话的过程中，院长达达隆还看了一眼恭敬侍奉站立在一旁的塞恩，眼中尽是长辈对晚辈的满意和欣赏。
“你新收的这个弟子不错嘛，才几个月时间就已经晋升中级学徒了。”
事实上，黑魔法学院的正式黑魔法师们爆发不可调和冲突后，一般都是对方出马调解。
对方强大的实力以及院长的头衔，足以调解一般的问题矛盾。
“院长，如果只是造成了实验事故和我那几个弟子受伤，也就罢了。”

“可是你要知道，就连水元素裂变发生器，也因为那个家伙的打扰而制作失败。”
“当初马丁院长找我出山，并最终我大老远从西方群岛赶来这里是为了什么，院长你应该不会不知道吧？”摩西多淡黄色的眼珠不为所动的说道。
“什么？水元素裂变发生器制作失败了！”
院长达达隆果然没有再继续袒护凯瑟森，而是神情紧张的问道。
面对院长的询问，摩西多摩挲了一下自己的金属魔法杖，淡淡说道：“重新制作是可以的，但是我的实验台修复需要一段时间。”
摩西多的回答，让院长达达隆轻舒了一口气。
但同样这位院长也意识到，他这次这个和事佬，怕是不好当了。
摩西多几天前，将凯瑟森从黑魔法学院，一直追到魔索布拉城的南城区。
最后又从南城区，一路追到东城区。

>Chapter 26 Lobbyists (Page 1)
When the figures of the two official black magicians gradually disappeared, the owl's hoot of "Cuckoo" slowly came.
In fact, these college monitors have arrived long ago, but unfortunately, even they did not dare to rashly participate in the battle between the two official black magicians.
I don't know if there are other black magicians nearby who are secretly watching, but Thane saw the Owl Academy monitor he knew - Qi.
The reason why he was able to recognize each other at a glance among several owls that looked very similar was because he had been in contact with each other many times. Thain noticed that one of the white feathers on the other person's chest was red, which was different from other owls.
Owl Qi probably also saw Thain, but it didn't come forward to say hello.
After separating two owls to guard the surrounding environment and the corpse of the burning plant monster, Qi and the other owl monitors flew in the direction where Master Mosido and Katherson left.
There has not been an official battle between black magicians in the city of Mensobra for more than ten years.
It is not known whether this battle will cause huge losses to the college or the city.
"Hahaha, since that guy Katherson has apologized and you dug out his pet's heart of life, I think we can just forget about it."
Still in Master Mosheduo's room, a distinguished guest came to visit today.
This visitor Thane also knew was Master Dadalon, one of the three vice-presidents of the Black Magic Academy in Mensobra City.
Since the battle between two formal black magicians that took place a few days ago also involved Thane, Thain, who was only an intermediate apprentice, also appeared in the room at this time.
The Master Dadalon in front of him was not at all the philistine and cold person he had been in the dungeon a few months ago. Instead, he had a warm face, like an old man next door, and he spoke warm words to Moses.
And during the conversation with Mosheduo, Dean Dadalon also glanced at Thain who was standing respectfully at the side. His eyes were filled with the satisfaction and appreciation of the elder for the younger one.
"Your new disciple is pretty good. He has been promoted to an intermediate apprentice in just a few months."
In fact, when irreconcilable conflicts break out among the official black magicians of the Black Magic Academy, the other party usually steps in to mediate.
The other party's strong strength and title of dean are enough to mediate ordinary conflicts.
"Dean, if it only caused an experimental accident and injured a few of my disciples, that's it."
"But you have to know that even the water element fission generator failed to be made because of that guy's interference."
"When Dean Martin asked me to come out, and finally why I came all the way from the Western Islands here, Dean, you don't know, right?" Moses said unmoved with his pale yellow eyes.
"What? The production of the water element fission generator failed!"
As expected, Dean Dadalon did not continue to protect Katherson, but asked nervously.
Facing the dean's inquiry, Moses touched his metal magic wand and said calmly: "It's okay to make it again, but it will take some time to repair my experimental bench."
Mosheduo's answer made Dean Dadalon breathe a sigh of relief.
But the dean also realized that he might not be a good peacemaker this time.
A few days ago, Moses chased Katherson from the Black Magic Academy to the southern part of Mensobra City.
Finally, they chased him all the way from Nancheng District to Dongcheng District.
